title: Winey French Potatoes Hash
description: A crispy, flavorful French dish featuring chives and katsuramuki-cut potatoes, perfect for breakfast or dinner. Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: Russet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into katsuramuki (thin wedges)

instructions: Heat the butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, until they begin to brown.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Stir in the chopped chives and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes are crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chives if desired.
Adjust seasoning as needed before serving.
Be careful not to overcrowd the skillet, cook in batches if necessary.
Don't skip the wine, it adds a lot of flavor to the dish!
Chives are a must, they add a bright and oniony flavor to the dish.
If using leftover potatoes, reheat them before cooking, they might be a bit dry.
